s.note: Goat's cheese log rolled in herbs and lemon zest, with honey and crackers
s.how: Roll a 250g log of goat's cheese in finely chopped rosemary, thyme, a pinch of dried lavender and lemon zest. Drizzle with honey and serve with crackers. Keep a sprig of rosemary on the board for luck.

m.note: Lemon, garlic and rosemary roast chicken with potatoes, carrots and gravy
m.how: Stuff a 1.8kg chicken with a halved lemon, 4 garlic cloves and rosemary. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes with 800g potatoes and 3 carrots in the tray. Rest, then make a quick gravy from the juices with lemon.

w.note: Chocolate buttermilk cake with chocolate frosting
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 3 eggs, 200g sugar and 200ml buttermilk, then fold in 200g flour and 1 tsp bicarb. Bake at 170C for 35 minutes. Frost with 250g icing sugar beaten with 40g cocoa and 80g butter.

w.note: Buttery shortbread flavoured with dried lavender
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g caster sugar, then mix in 350g flour and 1 tsp dried lavender rubbed between your fingers. Press into a tray, prick and bake at 160C for 25 minutes. Dust with sugar and cut while warm.

d.note: Tequila, orange liqueur and lime shaken, with a flaky salt rim
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime juice hard with ice. Strain into a glass rimmed with flaky salt. Makes four. Best after midnight in the kitchen.
